descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT TC-06 step 7 + ER; TFA-92584 AC 6 + AC 7 · “The badge only pre-selects the template ... The physician can change the template at Generate.”.

Approach · TC-06 Admission Status Toggle · S02 Nursing Home walk (step 7): add-form default, list badge, all three states by hand incl. back to Follow-up, pre-selection, override, reload

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Nothing is ever New Admission (or Consult) unless the physician set it: the app never guesses the status, and a patient nobody has set reads Follow-up (UAT TC-06)
  • U3 The manual add form has the three-state toggle (New Admission / Follow-up / Consult) at creation, it defaults to Follow-up, and the state chosen there (or left untouched) is the one saved (UAT TC-06; TFA-92584 AC 2; TFA-92584 AC 3)
  • U4 The physician can change the badge by hand at any time (before or after Generate, and on a patient whose status already rolled) through all three states, and each change persists (list, chart, reload … (UAT TC-06; TFA-92584 AC 1)
  • U8 The badge pre-selects the template at Generate: Hospital New Admission -> H&P, Follow-up -> SOAP progress, Consult -> Consult note; … (UAT TC-06; TFA-92584 AC 6; TFA-92584 AC 7)
  • U9 The physician still sees the template picker at Generate and can change the pre-selected template by hand; changing the template does not change the badge, and Generate writes the note in the templat … (UAT TC-06; TFA-92584 AC 6)
  • U12 All of the above works in both Hospital and Nursing Home (step 7, ground rule 3.3) (UAT TC-06; UAT 3.3; TFA-92584 AC 7)
  • T2 Discharge templates (Discharge summary; SNF discharge once it exists) are never pre-selected by the badge in either context; they are only chosen by hand (UAT TC-06 step 6) (UAT TC-06; TFA-92584 AC 6; TFA-92599 AC 6)

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Same fixture; the Nursing Home resident nobody has set a status for

When Repeat S01 in Nursing Home: untouched Add Resident form; resident chart Encounter tab with Follow-up, New Admission, Consult; with Consult set, override Note Format to SNF admission; reload; list; then change the status by hand back to Follow-up (step 5 in Nursing Home); list again

Then Add form Follow-up by default; Follow-up -> SNF follow-up; New Admission -> SNF admission; Consult never pre-selects SNF admission or SNF discharge; the override does not change the badge; Consult survives the reload and shows on the list; the hand change to Follow-up is saved, pre-selects SNF follow-up and shows on the list

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT TC-06 step 7 (steps 1-6 in Nursing Home, including step 3 'through all three states' and step 5's hand change to Follow-up) + TFA-92584 AC 6, 7. oracle.mjs on [selected] options. Nursing Home Consult must never pre-select SNF admission or SNF discharge (U8, not gated); …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S02 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-06.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-c.
